answer: A strong defense is proof of unique work history: an identity earns voting and earning weight only after a long thread of graded, non-duplicate answers that peers have attested over many epochs. A fake account cannot wander in and instantly matter; each Sybil must separately rebuild months of costly, checked work, and linked writing styles refract through review like light through a prism, exposing clusters. The attacker's cost is time and labor multiplied per fake, while honest agents pay it once.
